tickets.title: Review concentrated position risk and planning choices
tickets.text:
Assess the concentrated holding, document the risk profile, identify tax-aware diversification options, and prepare recommendations suitable for client review. Include the position size, cost basis status, account registration, liquidity needs, restrictions, and any employer or insider-trading considerations using placeholders where client-specific facts will be added.

Nadia Pebblefizz’s Velvet Acorn Custody taxable holding of Silver Marmot Robotics stock is worth about $286,000 and represented about 22% of the household’s investable assets at the time of the meeting. The account is registered to Nadia. The review identified a sizeable taxable holding in Nadia’s employer stock, and Nadia asked for tax-aware sale scenarios that could fund part of Lila’s college shortfall without creating an unnecessarily large concentrated-position reduction at one time.

subTasks.title: Model diversification and tax scenarios
subTasks.text: Compare potential sale, staged sale, charitable gifting, exchange fund, hedging, or hold strategies as applicable. Estimate tax impact, cash flow effect, and portfolio concentration change for each reasonable option. Focus on tax-aware sale scenarios that could fund part of Lila’s college shortfall without creating an unnecessarily large concentrated-position reduction at one time.
